stockfish.version: Stockfish 17.1 by the Stockfish developers (see AUTHORS file)

label_policy.cp_policy: raw Stockfish centipawns, side-to-move-relative, converted to White-positive, then clipped
label_policy.mate_policy: magnitude = 2000 - 10 * min(|mate_distance|, 49); signed so that positive means White wins. Monotonic in mate distance and strictly above the centipawn clip bound.
label_policy.mate_zero_policy: mate == 0 means the SIDE TO MOVE is checkmated and has lost; the sign is taken from the side to move, not from the value, because zero carries no sign. Magnitude is the maximum (2000).
label_policy.clip_applies_to: cp labels only; mate labels are never clipped
label_policy.ordering: mate mapping -> perspective normalisation -> clipping (cp only)
